stem: The student wants to emphasize the study's main finding. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?

stem: The student wants to introduce the research to an audience unfamiliar with it. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?

options.A: Desert varnish, the dark, thin coating of manganese and iron oxides that forms on rock surfaces in arid regions, has long left scientists debating whether microbes help create it; to investigate, Ana Reyes's team analyzed varnish samples collected in the Mojave Desert using DNA sequencing.
options.B: Desert varnish, the dark, thin coating of manganese and iron oxides that forms on rock surfaces in arid regions, is now known to be created by microbes; Ana Reyes's team analyzed varnish samples from the Mojave Desert using DNA sequencing to learn how the process unfolds.
options.C: Desert varnish, the dark, thin coating of manganese and iron oxides that forms on rock surfaces in arid regions, has long left scientists debating whether microbes help create it; to investigate, Ana Reyes's team examined varnish samples from the Mojave Desert using electron microscopy.
options.D: Desert varnish, the dark, thin coating of manganese and iron oxides that forms on rock surfaces in arid regions, has long left scientists debating whether microbes help create it; to investigate, Ana Reyes's team analyzed varnish samples from the Atacama Desert using DNA sequencing.

stem: The student wants to present a cautious summary of the findings. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?

options.C: In Ilves's eight-week study of 28 adults, resting blood pressure improved while self-reported mood did not change; because the study identified an association rather than a causal effect, the team urges replication in larger groups.
